name: John Deere Coffeyville Works - Coffeyville KS

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus - no controlled truck entrance. Buildings sit on a large open parcel; access roads from US-169 lead directly onto the property and to the office entrance and material yards with no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. Street View (2025-10) confirms an open lawn frontage with no perimeter fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth present anywhere on the site.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal access roads from the public road to the docks/material yards are long and open; would hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors observed along the north/east face of the main building (dock-leveler shadows visible at z20) plus the satellite north warehouse; estimated 10-25 total, low-confidence count typical of a legacy component plant with scattered docks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A few trailers and material laydown observed in the east yard; no dedicated trailer-storage lot. 0-10 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks concentrated on the north/east building face; no clearly separated ship vs. receive clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Semi-rural site on the north edge of Coffeyville, KS, surrounded by farm fields and open land; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main manufacturing building plus an attached office building, a detached north warehouse, and other small structures - a campus of 4+ buildings.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer drop yard observed; component plant relies on material laydown yards instead.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed running into the property.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is semi-rural but adjacent to the town of Coffeyville and an established industrial area; cellular coverage likely adequate - connectivityIssue set false.
